name: journal-of-chengdu-sport-university
description: Use when targeting 《成都体育学院学报》(Journal of Chengdu Sport University) — a CSSCI comprehensive sport-science journal hosted by Chengdu Sport University, distinctively strong in sport history, ethnic traditional sport, martial arts, traditional health-preservation (养生) and sport culture, alongside general sport science. Best for historically/culturally grounded sport studies and ethnic-traditional-sport scholarship; route lab-based exercise science to the exercise-science-leaning venues and applied competitive work to 《中国体育科技》.
